control.description: a named numeric knob bound to node parameters, applied at compile time

control_target.description: a node id, or "$effect" for the document's own properties

node_beam.description: Analytic lightning / laser between two points.
node_beam.title: beam

node_camera.description: Preview camera; tools use it by default.
node_camera.title: camera

node_collider.description: A collision shape particles and volumes test against.
node_collider.title: collider

node_curve.description: A path used by emitters, trails, beams and motion.
node_curve.title: curve

node_decal.description: A projected sprite on the ground or a surface.
node_decal.title: decal

node_emitter.description: Produces particles for one particle_system, or acts as a source for a volume.
node_emitter.title: emitter

node_event.description: Triggers bursts on target emitters when something happens.
node_event.title: event

node_field.description: Sampled data grid (V1 evaluates only noise fields).
node_field.title: field

node_force.description: A force field applied to particles and volumes.
node_force.title: force

node_light.description: A dynamic light the effect casts onto the scene.
node_light.title: light

node_material.description: Surface description shared by particles, meshes, trails, beams and decals.
node_material.title: material

node_mesh.description: A renderable mesh, an emitter shape or a particle instance source.
node_mesh.title: mesh

node_noise.description: Parameter provider for forces and textures.
node_noise.title: noise

node_particle_system.description: Defines what a particle is: initial state, evolution over life, rendering.
node_particle_system.title: particle_system

node_texture.description: Procedural texture graph or file, baked by the compiler.
node_texture.title: texture

node_trail.description: A ribbon following a source node or a particle.
node_trail.title: trail

node_volume.description: A bounded volume: a procedural raymarched density field (mode: procedural) or, later, a fluid simulation (mode: simulation, a V1 stub that reports statistics). See docs/VOLUMES.md.
node_volume.title: volume

description: An AetherFX effect document (schema 0.1.0). Generated from aether::SpecRegistry.

description.description: one line describing the effect, for humans and libraries

time_scale.description: playback speed; effect_time = wall_time * time_scale, so the effect lasts duration / time_scale seconds

title: AetherFX Effect
